messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Active ingredient: semaglutide Inactive ingredients:
Ozempic injection: disodium phosphate dihydrate, propylene glycol, phenol, and water for injections.
Ozempic has a pH of approximately 7.4.
Hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide may be added to adjust pH.
Ozempic tablet: magnesium stearate and salcaprozate sodium
Wegovy injection: disodium phosphate dihydrate, sodium chloride, and water for injection.
Phenol and propylene glycol are also inactive ingredients in the single-patient-use Wegovy FlexTouch.
Hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide may be added to adjust pH.
Wegovy tablets: salcaprozate sodium (SNAC) and magnesium stearate
Rybelsus R1 formulation: magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, povidone, and salcaprozate sodium (SNAC).
Rybelsus R2 formulation: magnesium stearate and salcaprozate sodium (SNAC).
Triplet: ["semaglutide", "has inactive ingredient", "propylene glycol"]

The relation 'has inactive ingredient' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug includes the inactive ingredient specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'is salt form of': The subject drug is a salt form of the active pharmaceutical ingredient specified by the object entity.
C. 'releases medicine': The subject drug releases its active ingredient in the manner specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduced absorption by': The absorption of the subject drug is decreased due to the presence of the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
